headline: Northwind Robotics posts a record quarter

claims.evidence_quote: Revenue reached $8.4M, up 21% year over year, driven by industrial demand for the company's Atlas manipulator arm.
The company shipped 1,240 Atlas units during the quarter, a new record
reported fleet uptime of 99.2% across 312 deployed customer sites
The team grew from 61 to 86 employees, with most new hires in field engineering and controls software.
the company signed a multi-year battery supply agreement with Voltcraft Industries worth $2.4M per year
